display.purpose: Hero name and modal titles — bold, tracking-tight.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked eyebrows, status pills, tag chips.

shadows.name: glass-rest
shadows.purpose: Default card depth in light mode, paired with inset sheen.

shadows.name: glass-hover
shadows.purpose: Card on hover/focus, with 2.5px lift and blue border.

motion.name: ambient-float-2

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action (GitHub, Send, Copy-confirm). Signal Blue Deep fill, white label.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>Primary action</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; background:#2563eb; color:#fff; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; padding:0.625rem 1.25rem; border:none; border-radius:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Secondary action on glass (Copy, social). Translucent white fill, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.7); color:#0f172a; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.875rem; padding:0.625rem 1.25rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border-radius:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s; } .ds-btn-glass:hover { background:#fff; } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Tech-stack or filter tag. Monospace, 8px radius; selected state fills Signal Blue.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace; font-size:0.6875rem; color:#475569; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.8); border-radius:8px; padding:0.25rem 0.625rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#60a5fa; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#2563eb; color:#fff; border-color:#2563eb; }

components.name: Project Glass Card
components.description: Signature component. Frosted glass with a cursor-tracking radial refraction that fades in on hover; lifts 2.5px with a blue glow.
components.css: .ds-card { position:relative; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92); backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(190%); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(190%); border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.9); border-radius:24px; padding:1.5rem; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:inset 0 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,1), inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0 8px 24px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-card::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; background:radial-gradient(600px circle at var(--mouse-x,50%) var(--mouse-y,50%), rgba(59,130,246,0.1), transparent 45%); opacity:0; transition:opacity .4s ease; pointer-events:none; } .ds-card:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.98); border-color:rgba(59,130,246,0.45); box-shadow:inset 0 1.5px 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,1), 0 20px 40px -12px rgba(59,130,246,0.15); transform:translateY(-2.5px); } .ds-card:hover::before { opacity:1; }

components.name: Nav Floating Pill
components.description: Sliding active indicator under the desktop nav link. Positioned by JS (left/width); Signal Blue Deep fill.
components.css: .ds-navpill { position:absolute; top:0.25rem; bottom:0.25rem; border-radius:9999px; background:#2563eb; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Glass Modal Panel
components.description: Project detail modal: frosted panel, dimmed blurred backdrop, capped at viewport height with internal scroll.
components.css: .ds-panel { position:relative; width:100%; max-width:42rem; max-height:calc(100dvh - 3rem); border-radius:24px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92); backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(190%); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(190%); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); box-shadow:0 24px 60px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; } .ds-panel-body { padding:1.5rem; overflow-y:auto; }

narrative.overview: A glassmorphism portfolio in which live engineering data drifts inside slow, calm motion. Frosted glass panels float over a dark-to-light field of softly animated gradient orbs — blue, indigo, violet, and cyan blooms that drift on 18–22 second loops behind everything. The surface is quiet at rest and reveals its life only on interaction: a card lifts a few pixels and a blue refraction glow tracks the cursor; a Live Repos tab shows real GitHub stars and last-pushed timestamps pulled at view time. The personality is premium but approachable — the craft is the proof of competence, not a separate decoration from it. The system is built on Tailwind's default slate neutral scale with Signal Blue as the single interactive accent, and a small set of semantic status colors reserved for repository state.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass (blur + saturate + layered inset highlights) is the primary material, not a flat fill.
Signal Blue is the only interactive accent and is used sparingly — its rarity is the point.
Depth and life appear as a response (hover, focus, live data), never at rest.
Live GitHub data is a first-class visual element, not a screenshot.
Motion is slow and ambient (18–22s loops); the system feels calm, not busy.

rules.name: The Signal Blue Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue carries every interactive and 'live' signal — links, focus, the active nav pill, and the card hover glow. It appears on roughly 10% or less of a screen; its scarcity is what makes it read as active rather than decorative.

rules.name: The Resting Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass surfaces are calm and flat at rest. The blue refraction glow, the border brightening, and the lift appear only as a response to hover, focus, or live data — never by default.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: One typeface (Inter) for the entire system. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and tracking — never from switching families.

dos: Do keep glass at blur(24px) saturate(190%) with the layered inset sheen.
Do reserve Signal Blue for interactive and 'live' signals only.
Do keep the card mouse-refraction and the 2.5px hover lift.
Do keep motion slow (18–22s ambient loops) and ambient.
Do keep content inside the 56rem column and above the pointer-events-none aurora layer.
donts: Don't use hard, opaque drop shadows as the primary depth cue.
Don't introduce saturated neon colors outside the status set (emerald / rose / cyan / amber).
Don't shrink control radii below 12px or card radii below 24px.
Don't let ambient orbs sit above content or cover text.
Don't treat Live Repos as decorative: it must show real GitHub data or fall back honestly.
